scope: Proposition 2.5 of the manuscript “Bounded anticanonical metrics on klt pairs and torus quotients” (preprints/Bounded-anticanonical-metrics-on-klt-pairs-and-torus-quotients-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 068 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2420934378c18da6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The line bundle V admits a singular Hermitian metric whose local weights are psh and locally bounded on all of Y .
